name: Edge-Octree Construction for Meta-Cell Adjacency
definition: A hierarchical structure used to connect cells that are spatially adjacent but belong to different meta-cells, specifically along edges shared by multiple meta-cells. It solves the problem of hierarchical disconnection between adjacent cells in an adaptive octree built from meta-cells.
summary: Edge-Octree Construction modifies Morton codes by embedding meta-cell identifiers to resolve topological disconnections between cells in adaptive octrees, creating a unified hierarchy for boundary processing.
